experiments.scope: Exact sha3-256-r5-prefix-v1 on 64-byte single-block messages. Per organizer seed, 256 groups with SHA-256-derived 64-byte prefixes, one per bit position of a full 256-position batch, 2 messages each (z = gray(t), t = 0, 1; LE32(z) XORed into bytes 0..3 and 40..43), N_t = 2^9. Digests used for matching come only from the bitsliced grouped evaluator of proof.md Sections 4-5 (Gray-updated A2 from coefficient words on the 62-word support, bitsliced rounds 2-4, row-0 round 5 (the last round), delta-swap transpose to 256-bit keys). The first pair agreeing on an 18-bit mask spread over digest lanes 0-3 is returned; failures return two nulls. In every trial the first 4 keys in processing order and the last key (last group at the last, Gray-updated z) are checked at full 256-bit width against an independent direct 5-round sponge, and the z-dependence of A2 is checked to vanish outside the 62 support words; any failure aborts the run.
experiments.hypothesis: As heuristic H1 predicts, the masked digests of the grouped message set behave like independent uniform 18-bit values: the success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with the uniform-model value 0.3931 for N_t = 2^9 and w = 18 (N_t^2/2^w = 1, the same ratio as N^2/2^256 in the full attack).

experiments.scope: As k5r5-bs-full-width, but each trial has 16 groups of 32 messages (z = gray(t), t = 0..31, so A2 is Gray-updated on z bits 0..4); 16 trials share one 256-position batch, each owning 16 bit positions (bitwise operations never mix positions, so trials stay independent). 18-bit mask on digest bytes 2, 12, 21, 28. Same full-width exactness and support checks; any failure aborts the run.
experiments.hypothesis: With 1/16 of the pairs inside a group, the success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with the uniform-model value 0.3931.

experiments.scope: As k5r5-bs-full-width, but all N_t = 2^9 messages of a trial lie in one group (one bit position; z = gray(t), t = 0..511, Gray updates on z bits 0..8): the strongest within-group structure, a negligible share of pairs at full scale. 256 trials share one batch. 18-bit mask on the top bits of digest lanes 0-3. Same full-width exactness and support checks; any failure aborts the run.
experiments.hypothesis: Even when every message shares one prefix and A2 is affine in only 9 varying bits, the success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with the uniform-model value 0.3931.

experiments.scope: As k5r5-bs-full-width, but each trial has 4 groups of 128 messages with z = gray(t) << 25, t = 0..127, so every Gray update uses a coefficient column of z bits 25..31 (for bit j >= 27 the support positions j+36 and j+37 wrap around the 64-bit lane); 64 trials share one batch. 18-bit mask on digest bytes 4, 13, 22, 25. Same full-width exactness and support checks; any failure aborts the run.
experiments.hypothesis: With the varying bits at the top of z, the success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with the uniform-model value 0.3931.
